title: Assistance for Rough Sleepers and Measures to Help Them Cope with COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Conditions
what_it_is: Assistance for Rough Sleepers and Measures to Help Them Cope with COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Conditions

sections.label: Homeless seeking shelter during circuit breaker
sections.summary: During the circuit breaker, nearly 300 have come forward to seek shelter and assistance, including many affected by travel restrictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: During the circuit breaker, nearly 300 have come forward so far to seek shelter and assistance, including many who were affected by travel restrictions.

sections.label: S3P capacity for rough sleepers
sections.summary: All the S3Ps together can accommodate some 700 rough sleepers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Together, all the S3Ps are able to accommodate some 700 rough sleepers.

sections.label: Destitute homeless in Welfare Homes
sections.summary: About 1,900 homeless individuals who lack family support and cannot care for themselves are housed in Welfare Homes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There is a small proportion of homeless individuals who may be destitute as they lack family support and are unable to care for themselves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are currently about 1,900 such individuals housed in Welfare Homes.

sections.label: S3P partners offer spaces beyond circuit breaker
sections.summary: Some S3P partners in the PEERS Network are prepared to provide these spaces beyond the circuit breaker.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: A number of our S3P partners in the PEERS Network are prepared to provide these spaces beyond the circuit breaker.

sections.label: Establishing transitional shelter and S3P spaces
sections.summary: Transitional shelter spaces and spaces in S3Ps continue to be established to support them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Having said that, we continue to establish transitional shelter spaces as well as spaces in S3Ps to support them.

sections.label: Reaching out to bring homeless into S3Ps
sections.summary: Those known have been reached out to through partner networks to bring them into S3Ps for shelter, help and safety during the circuit breaker.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To the extent that we know them, we have reached out to them through our network of partners to bring them into the S3Ps in order for them to be sheltered from the open, in order for them to get help and in order for them to be kept safe during this circuit breaker period.

sections.label: Homeless bookings under Destitute Persons Act
sections.summary: The Member asked how many homeless people have been booked under the Destitute Persons Act, and there is no punitive penalty for being homeless.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Member asked, first, how many homeless people have been booked under the Destitute Persons Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There is no punitive penalty against a person being homeless.

sections.label: Reaching out to homeless people
sections.summary: PEERS partners, MSF and other agencies have reached out to homeless people to help them get GST Voucher, Merdeka Generation, Pioneer Generation, Solidarity and other support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, even before the COVID-19 pandemic,our PEERS partners, together with MSF and the other agencies, in reaching out and befriending homeless people have been working with them to ensure that they get the benefits under the GST Voucher, Merdeka Generation and Pioneer Generation packages and when they encounter some challenges, for example, because they do not have ICs and other issues, we have worked with the relevant agencies to make sure that those obstacles are removed to get the help that they need.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, likewise, even during this pandemic period, we have been reaching out to people who are homeless and see that they get the support they need, including working with CPF Board and other agencies, so that they get the Solidarity payment and other support.
